open_unknowns.description: Which Magic Outcome framing elicits specific reader experiences and useful action? Working context revision 2, underway/testing/next, reports six scheduled Substack Notes, an existing Substack and LinkedIn backlog, essays, newsletter signup and a subscriber survey. Reuse these assets; scheduled publication is not verified live delivery. Map the actual six Notes to overwhelm to agency, despair to hope, and outrage to joyful creation before identifying any uncovered hypothesis. These owner reports are planning context, not confirmed research findings.

Where do relevant readers already respond and act? Intake:q2 identifies voters in America as the intended starting audience; intake:q18 and working context revision 2 testing leave platform fit unresolved. Substack is the reference channel, not an exclusive platform or a proven winner.

Which existing essay, exercise or tool helps readers take a concrete next step? Intake:q6 reports Voter Choice, a daily-use private dictation tool and substantial writing/software work; intake:q8 reports thanks for writing about burnout and joyful social work. These provide source material and creator experience, not evidence of audience adoption or paid demand. Working context revision 2 gaps deliberately leaves the offer open; paid offers, leads and sales remain future stages.

Baseline measurements and attribution for existing essay visits, newsletter signups and survey responses are missing from this Venture record, not necessarily from the business. Source: working context revision 2 underway/gaps. Signals should retrieve available analytics and identify actual collection gaps rather than asking Muxin to reconstruct them.

probes.hypothesis: The existing six Notes may reveal different needs across the three Magic Outcome frames. Specific accounts of a stuck point or action would be more informative than broad agreement.
probes.conversation_question: What felt difficult before reading this, and what, if anything, feels possible now?
probes.expected_evidence: After plan review, inspect and cite each existing Note's actual source and identifier, map its frame and intended learning, and retain any uncovered frame as a gap rather than inventing coverage or replacing scheduled work. Once publication is independently established through the normal workflow, collect attributable replies and action reports. Distinguish expressed resonance, intended action and reported completed action; preserve contrary responses, measured zeros and unavailable observations separately.

probes.hypothesis: A small comparison outside Substack may reveal relevant readers that the reference channel misses, without requiring a larger content operation.
probes.conversation_question: Where did you encounter this piece, and what made it relevant to something you are dealing with?
probes.expected_evidence: Propose a two-week Content Studio test for review: reuse the six scheduled Substack Notes as reference material, and adapt at most two suitable existing pieces to LinkedIn and Bluesky, at most four additional posts total. LinkedIn reuses the reported backlog; Bluesky is an exploratory candidate, not an audience-location claim. Use source-grounded text adaptations with per-platform review, source links and attribution. Compare substantive responses, attributable visits and downstream actions within comparable observation windows; label results directional because audience, timing and format differ. Budget about three content hours weekly, expanding only if needed within the saved eight-hour ceiling. Use weekday daytime blocks, preserve most Fridays and all family evenings/weekends, require no employees or additional meetings, and remain within the overall 30-hour week. Posting pace remains proposed and unrecorded; nothing is automatically published or selected.

probes.hypothesis: An existing piece with one practical action may help some readers move beyond agreement toward doing something useful.
probes.conversation_question: What did you try after reading, if anything, and where did you get stuck?
probes.expected_evidence: Use the existing essays, survey and relevant tool demonstrations as sources after inspecting their actual contents and destinations. Preserve specific responses about attempted actions, obstacles and outcomes, with their source references. Treat Voter Choice enthusiasm as stated interest unless use is evidenced; the private dictation tool establishes creator experience only. Reuse existing signup and survey paths without creating a replacement survey, lead magnet or paid offer.

probes.hypothesis: Existing Signals-accessible records may support a baseline and connect some content exposure to essay visits, newsletter signups or survey responses.
probes.conversation_question: If the existing survey or replies already capture this, what brought you here and what did you do next?
probes.expected_evidence: Propose a Signals read of available historical and test-window analytics, preserving source, date range, platform, content identifier and attribution method. Report visits, signups and survey responses separately, with denominators only when supported. Identify unavailable integrations or untracked transitions specifically; do not ask Muxin to manually rebuild accessible analytics. Views indicate exposure, not conversion or paid demand; unattributed subscriber movement cannot be assigned to a post.
